description: This Java class provides functions to map JSON objects and arrays to BSON documents and arrays for MongoDB storage, including key name revision capabilities.

classes.name: JsonValueToDbEntityMapper
classes.description: A final class providing functions to map JsonObject and JsonArray to BSON documents and arrays, with configurable key revision.

methods.name: forJsonObject
methods.description: Creates a function to map a JsonObject to BsonDocument, utilizing a key name reviser.

methods.name: forJsonArray
methods.description: Creates a function to map a JsonArray to BsonArray, utilizing a key name reviser.

methods.name: mapJsonObjectToBsonDocument
methods.description: Private method mapping a JsonObject to a BsonDocument for MongoDB storage.

methods.name: mapJsonArrayToBsonArray
methods.description: Private method mapping a JsonArray to a BsonArray for MongoDB storage.

methods.name: mapJsonValueToJavaObject
methods.description: Converts a JsonValue to a Java Object suitable for MongoDB storage.

methods.name: mapJsonValueToBsonValue
methods.description: Converts a JsonValue to a BsonValue object for MongoDB, handling various JSON types.

methods.name: reviseKeyName
methods.description: Revises a JsonKey's name using the configured reviser function.

methods.name: mapJsonNumberToJavaNumber
methods.description: Maps a JsonValue of number type to a Java Number.

methods.name: mapJsonNumberToBsonNumber
methods.description: Maps a JsonValue of number type to a BsonNumber for MongoDB.
